Read this Instructions for Use before giving TIVICAY PD.
Follow the steps below, using clean drinking water to prepare and give a dose to an infant or a child who cannot swallow the tablets.

paragraph.content: Important Information You Need to Know Before Preparing and Giving TIVICAY PD.

td.paragraph: Always give this medicine exactly as your healthcare provider tells you. Talk to your healthcare provider if you are not sure.

list.item: •TIVICAY PD is for oral use only (taken by mouth).
•Take TIVICAY PD with or without food.
•TIVICAY PD may be swallowed whole or prepared as an oral suspension.
• Do not chew, cut, or crush the tablets.
•If you forget to give a dose of medicine, give it as soon as you remember. Do not give 2 doses at the same time or give more than your healthcare provider has prescribed.
•If your child does not or cannot take the full dose, tell your healthcare provider.
•If you give too much medicine, get emergency medical help right away.
•If your child is able and prefers to swallow the tablets, then you may skip the following steps.
•A bottle containing 60 TIVICAY PD tablets for oral suspension.

•Dosing kit:
o Cup: Use this to prepare and give the medicine to children.
o Syringe: Use this to give the medicine to infants.

paragraph.content: You will also need clean drinking water.

list.item:
•Pour clean drinking water into the cup.
The Water Volume Guide in Figure A shows the amount of water needed for the prescribed dose.
See Figure A.

td.paragraph: Do not use any other drink or food to prepare the dose.

list.item: •Add the prescribed number of tablets to the water. See Figure B.
•Swirl the cup gently for 1 to 2 minutes to disperse the tablets. The medicine will be cloudy. Take care not to spill any of the medicine. See Figure C.
•Check that the medicine is ready. If there are any lumps of tablets, swirl the cup until they are gone.

td.paragraph: If you spill any medicine, clean up the spill.
Throw away the rest of the prepared medicine and make a new dose.
You must give the dose of medicine within 30 minutes of preparing the dose. If it has been more than 30 minutes, wash away all the dose in the cup using water and prepare a new dose of medicine.

list.item: •Make sure that the child is upright. Give all the prepared medicine to the child. See Figure D.
•Add another 5 mL of drinking water to the cup, swirl, and give it all to the child.

item.content: Repeat if any medicine remains in the cup to make sure the child gets the full dose.

list.item: •Place the tip of the syringe into the prepared medicine and draw up all the medicine into the syringe by pulling up on the plunger. See Figure E.
•Place the tip of the syringe against the inside of the infant’s cheek. Gently push down the plunger to give the dose slowly. See Figure F.
•Add another 5 mL of drinking water to the cup and swirl. Draw up the remaining medicine into the syringe and give it all to the infant.

item.content: Repeat if any medicine remains in the syringe to make sure the infant gets the full dose.

td.paragraph: Allow time for the medicine to be swallowed.

list.item: •Wash the cup with water. See Figure G.
•Pull the plunger out of the syringe and wash the syringe parts separately with water. Allow parts to dry completely before reassembling and storing. See Figure H.
•All parts will need to be clean before preparing the next dose.
•Store TIVICAY PD tablets for oral suspension at room temperature below 86°F (30°C).

•Store TIVICAY PD tablets for oral suspension in the original bottle. Keep the bottle tightly closed and protect from moisture. The bottle contains a desiccant packet to help keep your medicine dry (protect it from moisture). Do not remove the desiccant packet from the bottle.

paragraph.content: Keep TIVICAY PD and all medicines out of the reach of children.

list.item: •When all the tablets in the bottle have been taken or are no longer needed, throw away the bottle, cup, and syringe based on your local household waste guidelines.
•You will get a new cup and syringe in your next pack.
